_comment: Darkheart Forest compatibility manifest (PD-097). A sidecar over data/environments.json: it never changes catalogue content, it only records which environments, or which features of them, a Darkheart traversal outcome may deal as a scene, with its own bilingual framing. Every scene is hand-reviewed; a scene whose source changed is withheld until it is re-reviewed. Contract: docs/data-contracts/darkheart-scenes.md. Re-pin a review with: node scripts/darkheart-review-report.js --pins <envId>.

reviews.rationale: A campfire can burn in any hex and the two features shown name no terrain. The environment's lore mentions plains and settlements, but a partial scene does not show lore.
reviews.note: Its potential adversaries (Black Hats, Merchant, Spy) are hostile and never shown. Left out for the safe-rest outcome: Ghost Story, Whelp… (Slaps Knee), Sorry, Friend (see the scene's excluded list).

reviews.rationale: Tagged universal; the respite text names no terrain and the 'wilds' it shelters from are generic.
reviews.note: FULL, with its potential adversaries hidden (adversaries: none): they are the creatures that threaten a camp, not part of the respite. Foreshadowing gives the GM a Fear when a PC voices a dread; that is the environment's own price of intimacy, not a threat, so it stays.
Snapping Vines is now used for hazard-fail-fear (briar-thicket-snapping-vines): under PD-098 'deadly' needs no numeric definition, and the scene's guidance tells the Master how to raise the damage.

Rejected for Darkheart: Hidden Entrance and A Series of Passageways (their own Progress Countdowns 3 and 4/6 compete with the outcome's countdown, and both need a tunnel network), Toll-Keepers (named Jagged Knife bandits from another setting, paid by a Fear spend).

Deferred: You Are Not Welcome Here for creature-fail-hope (the source says the guardians 'confront' the party, and whether that reads as neutral rather than hostile is an owner call; making it neutral would need an adaptation). Barbed Vines and Defiler for the fail-Fear outcomes (modest damage, a Minor Chaos Elemental is not a 'deadly' adversary).

Rejected: Defilers Feed the Roots for a neutral adversary (the Deeproot Defenders come to bleed the intruder, which is not neutral). Deferred: Cursed Flow for hazard-fail-fear (1d8+3 magic damage and Stress, modest for 'deadly').

Rejected for the pilot: Losing Track of Time (a witch and hound packs, but its whole content is the condition 'when a player fails a roll, spend a Fear'; showing it under an outcome that already decided the encounter would need a reviewed trigger adaptation). Deferred: Roots of Lethargy (hazard; deadly criterion), Fog of Time (an age change, no Darkheart outcome fits).
Not used: Dreaming Spirits (a threshold-reducing scent hazard) and Gloamtrap Pit (a Fear-spend trap); neither is an obstacle or a meeting.

The environment has no lore field and names its NPC, Luna, from The Sablewood Messengers. Shown as printed: the race works for any NPC and the name is a harmless detail. Its own countdowns (Distance 3, Time 3) are kept; the outcome states no countdown for an NPC in peril, so nothing competes.

reviews.reason: A two-faction mass battle tracked with token pools (The Tides of War). Every other feature reads or changes that pool, so no fragment stands alone, and a battle of dozens does not match any single Darkheart encounter.

reviews.note: Used for resource-success-fear: the lore is guarded by its own Defenders. Left out: Fae Trickery (a Loop 4 countdown that competes with the Darkheart outcome's own countdown).

Used whole for creature-fail-hope: a formidable being that judges the party instead of hunting it. Her listed adversaries are not shown with the scene; its encounter theme (sylvan) only offers the ambush she may lead the party into.

Used for landmark-success-fear through Disturbing Totems only, with the hag reference adapted away. Left out: Navigate the Woods (a Progress Countdown 6 that competes with the traversal), Spirits of the Damned (a Fear-spend summons) and Cage of Brambles (a damaging trap).
Used for an obstacle through Dense Forest, with its own countdown replaced by the Darkheart one. Left out: Burst of Cold, Torment of the Woods (a Stress on any low roll).
Tagged forest. Lava Burst and Jagged Pillars serve the deadly hazard; Obscured Paths the obstacle. Left out: Arcane Volatility (spellcasting), Living Stone (a Fear-spend summons).
Three separate fragments: The Indigo Flame (what consumed the place), Choking Ash (a countdown hazard), and the Flame guarded by Charcoal Constructs. Left out: Chaos Magic Locus, Grasping Vines.

Whole environment as a neutral but formidable court; Feast of the Fey alone as a side quest. The Fear-spend features (Marked, Silence) are the court's own menace and stay inside the whole-environment scene.
The Wild Hunt as a hostile pursuit; The Sky Opens as an obstacle. Left out: A Test of Fitness (formal duels).
Ley Line (adapted to remove its ambush) as a safe place; Ruins of a Lost Court for a prisoner in peril and a guarded find; Festival as a boon. Left out: Fey Knows Fey (ancestry advantage).

Tagged mountain and forest. Four separate fragments: Flames of Blue (omen), Ruined Building (foreshadowed danger), Chill Mists (hostile spirits), Step by Step (an obstacle, its Progress Countdown 8 replaced).
Slime Eruption as a deadly hazard; Trackless Vegetation as an obstacle with its countdown replaced. Left out: Stressed Out.
Three fragments: Twisted Grove (plants to find), Fractal Fissure (a deadly hazard), Meteoric Distortion (an obstacle).
Hopelessly Lost as an obstacle with the Lost Countdown replaced by the Darkheart one. Left out: Unpleasant Wildlife (a Fear-spend).
Whole environment as a hostile hideout; its listed Jagged Knife adversaries are the point.

Fragments of the blaze as a hazard and as the danger an NPC is caught in (a generated NPC is added by the page). Left out: Hunting the Firestarter and Bring the Rain (their own countdown and environment change).
Wish-Holder Tree and Aura of Possibility as a hopeful place. Left out: the wish-spirit features (Fear-spend summons).
Whole environment as a neutral, formidable goddess whose welcome can be overstayed.
Tagged settlement and forest. Preparations as a side quest, Clover's Tavern as a place to rest (scale adapted). Left out: Guest Privileges, Leave it to the Trees.
Eerie Silence as a dark omen. Left out: Swarm Tactics (an attack), Sandalwood Logs.

reviews.rationale: A dream can come to any hex, and the shown fragments name no terrain: they speak of dreams, an acquaintance and a haven.
reviews.note: Fragments only: Nightmare Attack (hostile), It's you, isn't it? (a side quest), City of Ulthar (adapted to a woodland hamlet). Left out: Dream Travel (a countdown that competes with the traversal).

reviews.rationale: A time loop names no terrain; Trapped NPCs speaks only of people caught in it.
reviews.note: Only Trapped NPCs, as a side quest. Left out: the rest of the loop (it needs the whole environment).

reviews.rationale: A moor is open, rolling land; with its moor wording changed to woods, the shown fragments (a procession of spirits, a stream of herbs) read in a forest.
reviews.note: Both fragments are adapted from moor to woodland. Left out: Haunted Howls (a Fear-spend attack), Fog Rolls In.

reviews.rationale: A crypt is underground; the shown fragments speak of memory and a well, so a barrow in a forest hill carries them with only the place named differently.
reviews.note: Remember the Fallen and The Well of Remembrance, adapted from a crypt to a barrow. Left out: Relive Your Failings, Torment Unleashed (a summons), Entering the Well (a Death-Move-sized choice).

reviews.rationale: Ruins are a settlement biome; a trapped chest in a ruin or a hollow tree is the same idea.
reviews.note: Only Reality Tearing Trap, adapted to a forest hollow. Left out: the ley-line features and Reality Anchor Failure.

excluded.name: Ghost Story
excluded.reason: Spends a Fear to frighten the party: a hostile beat the safe-rest outcome rules out.

excluded.name: Whelp… (Slaps Knee)
excluded.reason: Forces the party to use their downtime moves or leave camp, which pressures the rest instead of keeping it safe.

excluded.name: Sorry, Friend
excluded.reason: Spends 2 Fear so the stranger robs the party; contradicts a safe rest.

scenes.standaloneNote: The stranger, the fire and the stew are all introduced inside the two shown features; neither mentions Ghost Story, the stranger turning in, or the theft.

art.reason: The environment has no painting or approved thematic picture; the forest biome strip puts the fire in the Darkheart wood.

summary.en: A stranger’s fire burns steady where little else in the wood is safe. Share a story and some food, and the whole party can rest.
summary.ru: Костёр незнакомца горит ровно там, где в лесу почти нигде не безопасно. Поделитесь историей и едой — и весь отряд сможет отдохнуть.

art.reason: No painting or approved thematic picture exists for the environment; the forest biome strip sets the respite in the Darkheart wood.

summary.en: A rare pause: the flames hold the dark back long enough for the party to trade stories, share their worries and recover.
summary.ru: Редкая передышка: пламя на время отгоняет тьму, и отряд может делиться историями и тревогами и восстанавливать силы.

art.reason: No painting or approved thematic picture exists for the environment; the forest biome strip fits a sparse wood.

summary.en: A hush falls over a sparse wood. Something is already watching the party from between the trees, and its den is close.
summary.ru: В редком лесу воцаряется тишина. Из-за деревьев за отрядом уже кто-то наблюдает, а его логово совсем рядом.

art.reason: No painting or approved thematic picture exists for the environment; the forest biome strip fits a race through the wood.

summary.en: Someone is hurt and running out of time deep in the wood. The party can still reach them, but the forest fights every step.
summary.ru: Кто-то ранен и теряет время в глубине леса. Отряд ещё может успеть, но лес мешает на каждом шагу.

excluded.reason: A navigation hindrance; used by its own hazard scene.

excluded.name: Dreaming Spirits
excluded.reason: A scent hazard that lowers thresholds; not part of meeting an NPC.

excluded.name: Gloamtrap Pit
excluded.reason: Spends a Fear on a trap; not part of meeting an NPC.

scenes.standaloneNote: Roaming Wanderer is self-contained: it introduces an NPC from its own list of four, states what they want, and the Hope reward; it refers to no other feature.

art.reason: The catalogue's approved thematic picture for this environment is a sinister wood, which misleads for a friendly meeting; the plain forest biome strip does not.

summary.en: Someone who knows something about this wood steps out of the undergrowth. They will share it if the party can help with what they need.
summary.ru: Из подлеска появляется тот, кому есть что рассказать об этом лесе. Он поделится, если отряд поможет с тем, что ему нужно.

excluded.name: Dreaming Spirits
excluded.reason: A scent hazard that lowers thresholds; a different hazard.

excluded.name: Gloamtrap Pit
excluded.reason: Spends a Fear on a trap; a different hazard.

excluded.name: Roaming Wanderer
excluded.reason: An NPC meeting, used by its own scene.

scenes.standaloneNote: Green and Overgrown stands alone: shifting paths and disadvantage on Instinct Rolls to navigate; it refers to no other feature.

art.reason: The catalogue already approves this sinister-wood picture for the environment, and a wood that rearranges its own paths is menacing.

summary.en: The trail splits and shuffles behind the party. Finding the way through takes more than a good sense of direction.
summary.ru: Тропа расходится и перетасовывается за спиной отряда. Чтобы найти путь, одного чувства направления мало.

excluded.name: Snapping Vines
excluded.reason: Spends a Fear to deal damage; an attack rather than an obstacle (deferred for the deadly-hazard outcome).

scenes.standaloneNote: Both shown features speak only of 'the Thicket': movement under pressure at disadvantage, and losing the party on a failed navigation roll. Neither refers to Snapping Vines.

art.reason: No painting or approved thematic picture exists for the environment; the forest biome strip fits a thicket.

summary.en: Roots, vines and fallen logs knot the way into a maze. Moving fast here is how a party gets separated.
summary.ru: Корни, лозы и поваленные стволы сплетаются в лабиринт. Здесь спешка — верный способ потерять друг друга.

excluded.name: Barbed Vines
excluded.reason: A damaging, restraining hazard; not part of a quiet site.

excluded.name: You Are Not Welcome Here
excluded.reason: Guardians confront the party; a creature encounter (deferred, see the review note).

excluded.name: Defiler
excluded.reason: Spends a Fear to summon a Minor Chaos Elemental; hostile, not part of a landmark.

scenes.standaloneNote: Overgrown Battlefield is a self-contained investigation of the old fight (three findings and a roll); it refers to no other feature.

art.reason: The catalogue already approves this forgotten-ruins picture for the grove, and a ruined, battle-scarred grove reads as a tragic site.

summary.en: Broken weapons, gouged earth and the mossy corpse of a treant mark where a battle in an old grove ended. No one ever set it right.
summary.ru: Сломанное оружие, изрытая земля и поросший мхом труп энта отмечают место, где закончилась битва в старой роще. Никто так и не исправил случившегося.

excluded.name: Cursed Flow
excluded.reason: A damaging magical hazard; deferred for the deadly-hazard outcome.

excluded.name: Defilers Feed the Roots
excluded.reason: Deeproot Defenders attack an intruder; a hostile encounter.

scenes.standaloneNote: Secrets of the Dead is self-contained: an Instinct Roll to learn parts of a hidden truth, with its three guiding questions inline; it refers to no other feature.

art.reason: The catalogue approves this sinister-wood picture as a strong fit for the glen, and it carries both the omen and the buried truth.

summary.en: Souls linger under the dark canopy, and the wood seems to remember what was done here. A shadowed truth waits just out of reach.
summary.ru: Под тёмным пологом леса задерживаются души, и кажется, что лес помнит, что здесь было сделано. Сумрачная правда ждёт совсем рядом, но недосягаема.

summary.en: The Darkheart roll that brought the party here has already failed, so Secrets of the Dead is read at its own failure result instead of asking for a second Instinct Roll.
summary.ru: Бросок Darkheart, приведший отряд сюда, уже провален, поэтому «Secrets of the Dead» читается по собственному результату провала вместо второго броска Инстинкта.

changes.source: On a failure, a PC can mark a Stress to learn one and gain Advantage on the next action roll to investigate this environment.

adapted.en: The traversal roll is the failed roll: a PC can mark a Stress to learn one part of the truth and gain Advantage on the next action roll to investigate the glen.
adapted.ru: Бросок перехода и есть проваленный бросок: персонаж может отметить Стресс, чтобы узнать одну часть правды и получить Преимущество на следующий бросок действия для изучения лощины.

changes.why: Applies the source's own failure branch, word for word, to a failure that already happened. No cost, number or result is new, and the GM still decides which of the three parts is learned.

summary.en: The glen gives up its secret: what happened here, what hides it, and what it will cost to bring it into the light.
summary.ru: Лес выдаёт свою тайну: что здесь случилось, что её скрывает и чего будет стоить вынести её на свет.

summary.en: The Darkheart roll that brought the party here has already succeeded with Hope, so Secrets of the Dead is read at its own Hope result instead of asking for a second Instinct Roll.
summary.ru: Бросок Darkheart, приведший отряд сюда, уже удался с Надеждой, поэтому «Secrets of the Dead» читается по собственному результату успеха с Надеждой вместо второго броска Инстинкта.

changes.source: On a success with Hope, learn all three parts of the truth.

adapted.en: The traversal roll is the successful roll: the party learns all three parts of the truth.
adapted.ru: Бросок перехода и есть удавшийся бросок: отряд узнаёт все три части правды.

changes.why: Replaces the roll with the result the source gives for exactly this outcome (success with Hope: all three parts); nothing is added or lost.

excluded.name: Fog of Time
excluded.reason: Spends a Fear to age or rejuvenate a PC; a separate effect, no Darkheart outcome fits.

excluded.name: Roots of Lethargy
excluded.reason: A damaging, restraining hazard; not part of a resource find.

excluded.name: Losing Track of Time
excluded.reason: A Fear-spend summons of a witch and hound packs; a hostile encounter.

scenes.standaloneNote: Valley Flora lists its three plants inline and refers to no other feature.

art.reason: The environment's own painting shows lilies, ivy and iridescent leaves in the foreground, so it represents a harvest of the valley's plants.

summary.en: Strange blooms crowd the valley floor, each thriving where little else could. Anyone who knows plants can fill a pack.
summary.ru: Диковинные цветы теснятся на дне долины, и каждый процветает там, где мало что выживет. Тот, кто знает растения, наполнит ранец.

summary.en: The Darkheart roll that brought the party here has already succeeded with Hope, so Valley Flora is read at its own Hope result instead of asking for a Knowledge or Instinct Roll.
summary.ru: Бросок Darkheart, приведший отряд сюда, уже удался с Надеждой, поэтому «Valley Flora» читается по собственному результату успеха с Надеждой вместо броска Знания или Инстинкта.

changes.source: On a success with Hope, they find all three of the below plants.

adapted.en: The traversal roll is the successful roll: the party finds all three plants (Blossomveil Ivy, Nursewood, Witherroot).
adapted.ru: Бросок перехода и есть удавшийся бросок: отряд находит все три растения (Blossomveil Ivy, Nursewood, Witherroot).

changes.why: Replaces the roll with the result the source gives for exactly this outcome (success with Hope: all three plants); nothing is added or lost.

excluded.name: Hidden Entrance
excluded.reason: Needs a tunnel entrance and carries its own Progress Countdown (3) that would compete with the outcome's countdown.

excluded.name: A Series of Passageways, All Alike
excluded.reason: Carries its own Progress Countdown (4 or 6) and needs a tunnel network.

excluded.name: Toll-Keepers

scenes.standaloneNote: Root Blockage is self-contained: the path is blocked, and the party can dig (Finesse), cut (Strength) or turn back (Instinct); it refers to no other feature.

art.reason: No painting or approved thematic picture exists for the environment, and its underground tunnels would mislead; the forest biome strip shows the tree on the path.

summary.en: A great tree has shifted and closed the way. The party can dig around it, cut through it, or look for another road.
summary.ru: Огромное дерево сдвинулось и перегородило путь. Отряд может подкопать, прорубиться или поискать другую дорогу.

summary.en: Only the printed place name is glossed: the source says a Sablewood tree, the scene reads it as a tree of the forest the party is crossing. Every roll and option stays as printed.
summary.ru: Поясняется только напечатанное название места: в источнике сказано «дерево Sablewood», в сцене это читается как дерево леса, по которому идёт отряд. Все броски и варианты остаются как напечатаны.

changes.source: a great Sablewood tree

adapted.en: A great tree of the forest the party is crossing; read “Sablewood” as that forest.
adapted.ru: Огромное дерево леса, по которому идёт отряд; «Sablewood» читайте как этот лес.

changes.why: Glosses a proper noun from another setting; the three ways past (Finesse, Strength, Instinct) and every roll are unchanged, and the source text is shown unaltered with the gloss beside it.

excluded.name: Disorienting Canopy
excluded.reason: A navigation setback that already serves the obstacle scene (briar-thicket-tangled-way); a second hazard would muddy this one.

scenes.standaloneNote: Both shown features speak only of 'the Thicket': a movement penalty under pressure and flora that strikes intruders. Neither refers to Disorienting Canopy.

art.reason: No painting or approved thematic picture exists for the environment; the forest biome strip fits a thicket.

summary.en: The briars are not a maze this time but a trap: the way forward is the only way out, and the vines are waiting for someone to move.
summary.ru: На этот раз терновник — не лабиринт, а ловушка: путь вперёд — единственный выход, и лозы ждут, пока кто-нибудь шевельнётся.

text.en: The Darkheart countdown (6) is the clock; Snapping Vines is how it bites. Raise the vines' damage to severe if the Master wants the hazard to feel deadly.
text.ru: Отсчёт Darkheart (6) — это часы; «Snapping Vines» — то, как они кусают. Если нужна по-настоящему смертельная опасность, поднимите урон лоз до тяжёлого.

excluded.name: Fae Trickery
excluded.reason: A Loop 4 countdown that competes with the Darkheart outcome's own countdown (1d6).

scenes.standaloneNote: Faestone Lore names only 'Defenders of the Stones', which is shown with it; Defenders of the Stones refers to no other feature.

art.reason: No painting or approved thematic picture exists for the environment; the forest biome strip fits a lit wilderness.

summary.en: Glowing runes cover a ring of stones, and everything they know about the wood is yours for the reading, if the wood allows it.
summary.ru: Светящиеся руны покрывают кольцо камней, и всё, что они знают о лесе, можно прочесть — если лес позволит.

text.en: The guardians are the Master's dial: send fewer Tangle Brambles against a small or hurt party, or let the Darkheart countdown alone stand for the guard.
text.ru: Стражи — рычаг Мастера: против малого или раненого отряда выпускайте меньше Тангл Брамблов или пусть стражей заменит один лишь отсчёт Darkheart.

art.reason: No painting or approved thematic picture exists for the environment; the forest biome strip fits a figure seen between the trees.

summary.en: A golden-haired figure steps from between the trees, neither threat nor friend, and the way she looks at the party is a question.
summary.ru: Золотоволосая фигура выходит из-за деревьев — не угроза и не друг, и её взгляд на отряд — это вопрос.

text.en: She is formidable but not hostile: let the party talk. If they fail her judgment, her ambush can come from the wood itself, or turn her into a foe.
text.ru: Она грозна, но не враждебна: дайте отряду поговорить. Если он не пройдёт её суд, засада может выйти из самого леса — или она сама станет врагом.

scenes.standaloneNote: Disturbing Totems names only 'the Forest' and the hag; it refers to no sibling feature.

art.reason: The catalogue approves the sinister-woods picture for this environment; a twisted effigy in a shadowed wood is exactly its subject.

summary.en: Something has been arranged here on purpose: an effigy built of the wood's own litter, facing the way the party has yet to go.
summary.ru: Здесь что-то выложено нарочно: чучело из лесного сора, обращённое туда, куда отряду ещё идти.

text.en: Let the totem foreshadow whatever you have in mind for the next hex. The Presence roll is optional: use it if the party studies the totem too long.
text.ru: Пусть тотем предвещает то, что вы приготовили для следующего гекса. Бросок Присутствия необязателен: используйте его, если отряд слишком долго разглядывает тотем.

summary.en: The source ties the totem to a specific hag; here it is the work of whatever haunts this stretch of the forest, so it can foreshadow any danger.
summary.ru: В источнике тотем принадлежит конкретной ведьме; здесь это дело того, что обитает в этой части леса, поэтому он может предвещать любую опасность.

adapted.ru: искажённое чучело того, что обитает в этой части леса

summary.en: A fey court of towers and bridges, ruled by a Queen who is neither friend nor enemy and who is far too strong to be brushed aside.

text.en: The court is courteous and dangerous. Let the party talk: force only follows a slight to the Queen.
text.ru: Двор вежлив и опасен. Дайте отряду поговорить: сила применяется лишь за оскорбление Королевы.

text.en: She is formidable, not hostile: the danger is overstaying her welcome.
text.ru: Она грозна, но не враждебна: опасность — злоупотребить её гостеприимством.

text.en: Play it as a landmark seen from a distance: rest nearby is allowed, but only 1 downtime move. The fence and the watch are what lies ahead if the party goes closer.
